en: Illustrated interior view of an elegant early‑20th‑century restaurant or café, drawn in a Viennese Secession / Wiener Werkstätte style. The room is filled with square tables covered with white cloths and surrounded by wooden chairs with round seat cushions. The walls are made of light-colored glass blocks with geometric stained-glass panels and hanging flower baskets. A bar or service counter with bottles is visible at the back under a large wall clock. Above the room hangs a large circular chandelier with multiple lights. Along the left border runs vertical text, and at the lower right the artist's name is printed.
